description: This Java class 'ContentItem' encapsulates a content item for sharing purposes in an Android application. It manages content types (image or text), provides methods to retrieve content URIs, and creates share intents based on content type.

classes.name: ContentItem
classes.description: A class representing a content item, which can be either a resource or an asset, providing methods to generate URIs and sharing intents based on its content type.

methods.name: ContentItem
methods.description: Constructor for creating a ContentItem referencing a resource ID, specifying its content type.

methods.name: ContentItem
methods.description: Constructor for creating a ContentItem referencing an asset file path, specifying its content type.

methods.name: getContentUri
methods.description: Returns a Uri pointing to the content if an asset path is provided, or null otherwise.

methods.name: getShareIntent
methods.description: Creates an Intent suitable for sharing the content item, with proper MIME type and intent extras based on content type.
